import os, pty, subprocess, time, select, signal

def run(args):
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    os.write(master, b'')
    p = subprocess.Popen(['./executable']+args, stdin=slave, stdout=slave, stderr=slave, close_fds=True, env={**os.environ,'TERM':'xterm','COLUMNS':'80','LINES':'24'})

    end=time.time()+2
    while time.time()<end:
        r,_,_=select.select([master],[],[],0.1)
        if r:
            try:
                chunk=os.read(master,4096)
                if not chunk: break
                out+=chunk
            except OSError:

        if p.poll() is not None:
            # drain
            try:
                while True:

    if p.poll() is None:

    print(out.decode('utf-8','replace').replace('\x1b','^[')[:3000])
